name: Product UI
oneLiner: a grey dot-grid canvas with soft black asterisks: the real logo strokes on, a cursor boxes the tagline, the real input bar is typed and pressed, a dark disc wipes to the real product turning in 3D and its video playing
bestFor: software products with a recognisable screen and a product video; launch teasers, feature drops, app intros that should feel designed and quiet; 9:16 social
motion: logo stroke-draw with getTotalLength then fill and pulse; cursor-dragged dashed boxes (power3.out); springy pops (back.out(1.9-2.2)); a typed query and a pressed button with an expanding ring; a giant disc wipe (power2.inOut); a card turning in perspective; a frame-stack video with a crop-in
ground: flat light grey #E8E8E8 with a 30px dot grid, no grain

sound.ui: a pop as the logo fills, a tick per selection box, a pop as the bar springs, typing under the query, a click on the press, a whoosh on the wipe, a shimmer as the video lands, one hit on the final mark
